Export the published tables as Parquet

Source: R/publish.R
jn_publish.Rd

Downloads tables from BigQuery, validates them against jn_schema() and writes zstd-compressed Parquet files to path, in the layout of the Hugging Face dataset (see jn_upload_hf()):

Usage

jn_publish(
  path,
  tables = jn_publish_tables(),
  raw_dir = "data-raw",
  config = jn_bq_config(),
  max_gb = 30
)

Arguments

path

Directory to write to.

tables

Tables to export, see jn_publish_tables().

raw_dir, config

See jn_release().

max_gb

Stop before exporting an article table whose queries would scan more than this.

Value

The written file paths, invisibly.

Details

  • one file per table for the reference tables and the journal-level aggregates, e.g. journal_year.parquet, plus a release table (written with journal_year and also uploaded to BigQuery);

  • one folder per article table with one file per publication year, e.g. articles/articles_2025.parquet. These are read year by year from the tables partitioned by pub_year (see jn_build_table()), so each query scans only that year. Old files in the folder are removed first.

Each file carries its table name, the package version and the column descriptions as Parquet key-value metadata (jn_table, jn_version, jn_columns as JSON), readable for example with DuckDB's parquet_kv_metadata().
